intelligence.human_view: The promise is not a feature list, it is one page. Everything the citizen does lives in one place — mail, schedule, post, every operation — on the phone in their hand, all their data in one place that's secure. And it runs itself if they wish: Naya operates it for them, so they don't even have to write a single post if they don't want to. But the page is theirs to enter, not a machine that locks them out — if they want, they get in there: upload photos, share, comment. Automation and agency in the same place, by the citizen's choice. And the measure of the page is a feeling, not a spec: land on a NayaNET page vs land on an average social feed — a Facebook profile vs a NayaNET profile — a whole different world. Beautiful is not the decoration on the promise; beautiful is the proof the promise is kept. This is the anatomy (SN-2960) stated as a verdict: the page IS a smart app, and one smart app page is enough to change the world — because the world is what the page holds.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine ONE magic page that holds your whole world! All your pictures, all your friends, all your messages — safe in one place, right on your phone! And the magic page can do everything for you all by itself — you don't even have to write anything if you don't want to! But if you DO want to play, you jump right in — share photos, talk to friends, say hello! And it's so beautiful — not like a boring old page, but a whole different world!
intelligence.grandma_view: It's like this, love — one page, dear, that holds your whole world. Everything in one place on your phone, safe and secure: your mail, your appointments, your posts, everything — and it can all run itself if you like, so you don't have to lift a finger. But if you want to get in there, you can — share your photos, talk to your friends, leave a comment. And it's just beautiful, love — landing on a NayaNET page is a whole different world from an ordinary social feed. Like stepping into a lovely home instead of a noisy street.
intelligence.naya_view: One page changes the world. Everybody's world — smartphone, all their data in one place, secure. Mail, schedule, post, all operations — automated if they wish. No post required; jump in if they want — photos, share, comment. Beautiful: a NayaNET page vs an average social feed — a whole different world.
